title: Portfolio
description: A Blazor WebAssembly site on .NET 10. Project data is separate from the UI, tests cover loading behavior, and GitHub Actions deploys the published site to GitHub Pages.

title: Interactive Comments (React + .NET + AWS)
description: A threaded comment demo with a React and TypeScript frontend and an ASP.NET Core API. It supports replies, editing, deletion, and voting. The API uses in-memory storage, so comments may reset when its process restarts; the GitHub Pages frontend and API are deployed separately.
